--------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Akshay Kumar, Advocate For the Opp. Party : Mr. Vijoy Kumar Sinha,APP
For the Informant : Mrs. Vani Kumari, Advocate

--------
th Order No. 02/ Dated: 09 May, 2025 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Boarijore P.S. Case No. 26 of 2023 instituted under Sections 504 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that earlier anticipatory bail application filed by the present petitioner was rejected on merits by this Court vide Order dated 14.05.2024 passed in A.B.A. No. 10649 of 2023.
It is further submitted that complaint case no. 809 of 2023 has been instituted with an allegation that the petitioner has committed rape with the victim widow lady on the pretext of marriage.

It is further submitted that the fresh ground for renewing this petition is that both the petitioner and prosecutrix were under live-in-relationship and after rejection of the earlier anticipatory bail application, both of them solemnized marriage in a temple and both are living together peacefully and leading their marital life and have amicably settled and compromised their dispute.

4. On the other hand, learned Addl. P.P. appearing for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submitted that the factum of compromise between the parties is no ground for entertaining the second anticipatory bail application in such a serious and heinous nature of Gangalal Murmu @ Ganesh Murmu vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...

1 offence against the victim therefore this anticipatory 2025:JHHC:13983 bail application is fit to be rejected.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, gravity of offence and also in view of the fact that the offence is not compoundable in nature, I am not inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the prayer of anticipatory bail of petitioner is rejected.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Basant Gangalal Murmu @ Ganesh Murmu vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ... Opp. Party on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45945451/
